::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Decr 23d 1852  
**From:** Otterbourn  
**Manuscript:** MS Charles E. Young  Research Library,  UCLA, collection 100.
:::

[Sir](people/person_981.qmd)
I am obliged to you for forwarding the cheque for[£25](organizations/other_160.qmd) for the first edition of the [Two Guardians](cmy_books/cmybook_13.qmd).

I am at present too much engaged to think of publishing anything in the [Churchman’s Companion](organizations/other_62.qmd),[^1] though I am obliged to you for the proposal.

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: CMY had  contributed *The Two Guardians* (1850-2) to *The Churchman's Companion*, published by Masters.
